claim.summary: Conjecture: for the functional pigeonhole system over F_2 (pigeon axioms 1+sum_j x_ij, hole and functionality axioms, multilinear ring) with n+1 pigeons and n holes, at every proper degree D and K<=D-1, the common kernel in V_K of a set of variables modulo the degree-D closure C equals the common kernel modulo the closure H of the monomial axioms alone, plus C cap V_K. Evidence: K=1 at 6x5 (check:functional-factor-kernels) and K=2 at 6x5 and 7x6, all at D=3 (check:functional-kernels-k2), F_2 and m=n+1 only. Variable errors are load-bearing: non-monomial errors are governed by other memberships (check:truncated-kernel-beyond-support).
claim.assessment: Conjecture from finite checks at D=3 on two boards; a proposed route (unverified) is the dual design-extension form through prop:exact-operator-criterion at D<=ceil(n/2), which stops at a top-layer correction.

claim.summary: Exact F_2 computation (three_quantities.py with tools/pc_closure.py) on the functional pigeonhole system at D=3, K=2, comparing kernels of sets of variables modulo the closure C with those modulo the monomial-axiom closure H plus C cap V_2: at 6x5 (C dimension 4056, H 2995, C cap V_2 276) the diagonal sets {x00,x11,x22} and {x00,x11,x22,x33} and the sets {x00,x01}, {x00,x10}, {x00,x01,x11}, and at 7x6 (C cap V_2 469) the two diagonal sets, all have single excess 0, joint defect 0 and total excess 0, with surviving domain killers modulo C cap V_2 of dimension 36, 12, 68, 88, 41, 48, 12. Controls: K=1 excess 0 as recorded; a positive control (monomial axioms ab, bz, linear axiom w+a+z, D=2, K=1, F={w}) gives excess 1.
claim.assessment: Finite check by exact elimination; two committed runs; both controls passed.

claim.summary: Exact F2 computation with tools/pc_closure.py on the functional pigeonhole system (pigeon axioms 1+sum_j x_ij, hole and functionality axioms): refutation degree 3 at 3 and 4 holes and 4 at 5 holes; at 6 pigeons, 5 holes, D=3, K=1 (dim V_1=31, C cap V_1 the 6 pigeon axioms), for factor sets {x00,x10}, {x00,x01}, {x00,x11}, {x00,x11,x22}, {x00,x11,x22,x33} the common kernel of the factor maps has dimension 11, 9, 8, 6, 6 and equals the common kernel in the closure of the monomial axioms alone (dimension 5, 4, 2, 0, 0) plus C cap V_1. A positive control (monomial axioms ab, bz, linear axiom w+a+z, D=2, F={w}) gives 3 against 2, so linear axioms can transport killers and the equality is not generic. At 7 pigeons and 6 holes (proper at D=3, dim V_1=43, C cap V_1 the 7 pigeon axioms) the same sets give 13, 11, 9, 7, 7 against Ann_H 6, 5, 2, 0, 0 plus the relations, again equal.
claim.assessment: Finite check by exact elimination (functional_factor_kernels.py, functional_factor_kernels.json, the first run's output and the timeout); numbers checked by the reviewer, who supplied the positive control.

claim.summary: Exact operator criterion: over any field, for functional unary PHP^m_N (m > N), d <= ceil(N/2) and any set A of polynomials of degree <= d, with R the projection of span(T_d) onto span(T_d cap B_d) along K_d = span(B_d minus T_d) (the Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall basis and PC closure of the pigeon axioms, ECCC TR97-042 Prop. 2.8 and Thm 2.9), the degree-d PC closure of the pigeon axioms and A is K_d + W_A, W_A the smallest subspace containing R(a) and R(xw) for w in W_A with deg(xw) <= d; so PHP plus A has a degree-d refutation iff 1 is in W_A (the complete-board form of lem:relative-criterion, with converse). R(f) = 0 iff every functional vanishing on K_d kills f; the uniform design lambda(x_U) = 1/(N)_{|U|} is a PHP design, so dense clauses have R(C) != 0 when their uniform value is nonzero. Hardness of the functional system implies hardness of weak PHP plus A. The operator method reformulates hardness exactly and does not bypass the splitting condition.
claim.assessment: Working proof after a fresh-context review, given the imported basis theorem; part (3) is corrected by cor:uniform-design-characteristic (the uniform design needs (N)_d invertible, so over F_3 only d <= 2); parts (1), (2), (4) and the no-bypass conclusion stand.

formalization.scope: Informal proof or computation; no Lean verification.

significance.rationale: Develops and closes the operator lead: exactness shows the method is a reformulation, not a bypass, for dense clauses.
